messages.content: The engine on my bike is shot. I need a new one.

I have a rebuilt engine block, but it's one of a kind. It'll cost you.
{"give":[],"take":[]}
I'll give you my power armor helmet for it. [OFFER: power_armor_helmet]

A T-51b helmet? And in good condition... It's a deal. The engine is yours.
